title: IRDAI Mandates Ind AS 117 Accounting Standard from 1 April 2026
summary: **Mandatory Financial Reporting Standard:** Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) made **Ind AS 117 (Insurance Contracts)** mandatory ...

items: **Mandatory Financial Reporting Standard:** Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) made **Ind AS 117 (Insurance Contracts)** mandatory for all life, general, health, and reinsurance companies effective **1 April 2026**.
**International Alignment:** Aligns Indian insurance financial reporting with international IFRS 17 standards, introducing fair-value assessment of insurance contract liabilities.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Ind AS 117 governs Insurance Contracts, effective 1 April 2026.
